rules.rule: Every major action must query the Page Router for required pages
Required pages must be read and proof-of-read receipt generated before action proceeds
Missing required page blocks action until read or risk-accepted
Risk pages are read when corresponding risk signal is active
Page budget per action: small<3KB, medium<6KB, P0/high-risk up to 10KB
Always-on constitution is loaded in every session; report if >2KB
Proof-of-read does NOT prove understanding or correctness
Manual Router does NOT mutate governance state
